export_pytorch_model: export a PyTorch PreTrainedModel to Core ML MLModel format with optional float16 quantization
export_model: export a PyTorch or TensorFlow HuggingFace model to Core ML format using the unified export entry point
get_input_types: get Core ML input types for text, vision, or audio modality models with flexible sequence shapes
create_Wrapper_module: create a PyTorch nn.Module wrapper that handles past key values and task-specific output processing for Core ML conversion
get_shape_config: get a ct.Shape object with optional RangeDim for flexible sequence length or past key value dimensions
